source: Binance official public USD-M monthly archives; SHA256 verified
features: Completed UTC daily trade OHLCV aggregated from complete hourly bars; funding and mark prices are execution-only.
execution_prices: Hourly trade open and mark OHLC. Settlement mark is absent from funding CSV: hourly mark open is an explicit proxy; actual calc_time is retained and bucketed into its UTC hour.
publication: Public archive retrieval vintage only; historical publication/revision vintages unavailable. Daily features are known at UTC day close. Funding is realized execution cashflow, never a feature; the next settlement timestamp and backward interval prove coverage only, without using its rate.
membership: Fixed preselected configured assets across the imported interval; not a reconstructed historical dynamic universe.
